title: Disambiguate Project Memory workspace index selection
correctionCommitMessage: fix: bind query scope to project identity

correctionCommits.message: fix: bind Codebase index to workspace identity
fix: bind query scope to project identity

rootCause: Make index selection deterministic when multiple workspace paths exist for a project version.

finding.summary: Query index selection can be ambiguous when more than one workspace path exists for the same project version.
finding.remainingIssueBefore: The validated finding remained applicable at current HEAD: a query could select the first in-memory index matching only projectId/projectVersion even though canonical identity included the resolved workspace path.
finding.recommendedAction: Require workspace scope for queries or complete canonical workspace identity; do not fall through to first-match project/version selection.

authorityClassification: Codebase Memory is a read-only structural projection and bounded Factory-managed cache. The exact WorkspaceScope and source manifest bind local index, query, cache, and idempotency identity; the optional upstream transport does not become a competing Factory authority.

correction.before: CodebaseMemoryQueryPlan.workspaceScope was optional and findIndex could return the first index matching projectId/projectVersion, allowing two workspace paths for one project version to reuse the wrong index.
correction.after: Every query plan requires a complete WorkspaceScope. The plan projectId/projectVersion must match that scope, state is loaded for that exact canonical scope, and findIndex selects only the exact canonical workspace identity.
correction.reproduction: A deterministic two-workspace fixture with the same projectId/projectVersion and identical source was indexed at the ordinary version path and a valid staging candidate path. Baseline first-match behavior returned the ordinary-path index when the staging candidate was intended. The final regression rejects an unscoped plan, rejects project/scope mismatches, and returns only the intended staging workspace index.
correction.policyPreserved: Workspace validation, source-manifest construction, exclusions, secret boundaries, index currentness, cache/idempotency, durable state publication, restart/corruption/concurrency behavior, and the existing implementation consumer scope were preserved.

project.before: Query plan projectId was present, but it did not constrain an optional workspace scope and was insufficient to distinguish multiple workspace paths.
project.after: Query plan projectId is required and must equal workspaceScope.projectId; persisted state also validates the project binding.

projectVersion.before: Query plan projectVersion was present and part of the upstream project argument, but first-match selection could still choose another workspace for the same version.
projectVersion.after: Query plan projectVersion must equal workspaceScope.projectVersion and participates in canonicalWorkspaceIdentity and persisted-state validation.

workspace.before: workspaceScope was optional for queries, so callers could omit the path and trigger first-match reuse.
workspace.after: WorkspaceScope is required, validated, resolved, generated-root-contained, version-shaped, and included in the exact canonical identity.

sourceSnapshot.before: The source manifest checksum was already required and checked for READY index currentness, but it did not repair ambiguous workspace selection.
sourceSnapshot.after: The content-addressed source manifest remains unchanged and must match the exact scoped READY index before a query can run.

index.before: Index records already carried workspaceIdentity and indexId, but query lookup could ignore that identity when scope was omitted.
index.after: Lookup uses only canonicalWorkspaceIdentity(workspaceScope); indexId remains sha(canonicalWorkspaceIdentity + manifestChecksum).

cache.before: Cache entries were scoped internally, but an unscoped plan could still resolve the wrong index before cache use.
cache.after: The exact scope is mandatory and the existing cache key includes project/version/sourceManifest/operation/serialized plan plus the exact scope key.

query.before: A query plan could omit workspace identity and rely on first matching in-memory index order.
query.after: Query identity is bound to the complete workspace scope, matching project identity, current source manifest, operation, and query idempotency input.

optionalUpstream.role: The read-only adapter receives a project argument formatted from projectId and projectVersion; its remote project/index naming is not the local Factory workspace authority.
optionalUpstream.availability: UNAVAILABLE; codebase-memory-mcp was not on PATH and live smoke was not configured.

canonicalIdentity.absolutePathRole: The resolved absolute path is the workspace discriminator for this Factory-managed generated workspace architecture; it is not a whole-repository hash and is not used to grant write authority.
canonicalIdentity.sourceManifestRole: The manifest checksum is a separate content snapshot identity and freshness boundary; it is not replaced by the workspace identity.
canonicalIdentity.secrets: No secret values, source contents, credentials, or environment values are added to identity keys or persisted metadata.
canonicalIdentity.excludedFactoryArtifacts: The indexed workspace boundary excludes Factory administrative material outside the generated application version. Dotfiles, excluded directories, symlinks, and secret-like files remain excluded by the existing source policy; .context7-cache and .qa-foundation-* remain untracked operational artifacts and do not enter the indexed application workspace identity.

sourceScope.secretFilenameRule: ^\.env(?:\..*)?$ or names containing secret, credential, password, token, key, or ending in .pem
sourceScope.manifestAlgorithm: Sorted recursive file entries record slash-normalized relativePath, sha256, and byte count; the sorted file list is JSON-hashed.

currentnessAndInvalidation.readyQueryRequirement: The selected exact-scope index must be READY and its manifestChecksum must equal the query sourceManifestChecksum.
currentnessAndInvalidation.addedOrRemovedSource: Manifest file membership changes alter the checksum and cause the existing index status/currentness path to require refresh; the direct suite exercises added-source staleness.
currentnessAndInvalidation.contentChange: Source bytes are SHA-256 hashed, so content changes alter the manifest checksum.
currentnessAndInvalidation.irrelevantChange: Excluded directories, dotfiles, symlinks, secret-like files, and non-source extensions do not enter the manifest.
currentnessAndInvalidation.sameContent: Same scoped source content produces the same manifest checksum under the existing deterministic policy; scope identity still distinguishes different workspaces/projects.
currentnessAndInvalidation.mtime: Modification time is not used as source identity.

correctionSummary: Bound every Factory Codebase Memory query to the complete canonical WorkspaceScope, rejected mismatched project identity, and replaced first-match index reuse with exact canonical workspace lookup while preserving cg-09 durability and source-manifest currentness.
testsAdded: Two valid workspace paths with the same projectId/projectVersion cannot select each other's index.
An unscoped query plan is rejected by the query-plan contract.
A projectId or projectVersion mismatch between the query and workspace scope is rejected.
The intended scoped workspace is returned after both workspaces are indexed.
